title: Predefined/uppercase entities and numeric character references
method: Hand-derived from the pinned source rules named in provenance; no F1 hydrate, project or serializer output was observed or used.

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>A & B < C > D "E" F 'G'</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: The five predefined lowercase references decode with the pinned native semantics in element text.
provenance: plan rev d: only the five predefined references and numeric references decode

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>A & B < C > D "E" F &APOS;G&APOS;</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: All-uppercase variants of the five predefined names decode exactly like the lowercase forms in both lanes; this sealed behaviour is intentional native parity, not an error.
provenance: saxen decoding: uppercase variants are added to the same mapping
plan rev d: accept native uppercase variants in both lanes; seal a documenting vector

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>A &Amp; B</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: Mixed-case &Amp; is not one of the five names nor its all-uppercase variant; natively it would pass through literally, but the boundary admits only the closed decoded set and refuses the undeclared named reference.
provenance: plan rev d: closed decoded set and xml-entity-reference-unsupported
saxen decoding: unknown names fall back to literal text (the behaviour the boundary must not silently keep)

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>A   B</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: An undeclared named reference outside the closed set is refused at the boundary with a pointer at the containing text; it is neither decoded nor retained as literal text.
provenance: plan rev d: xml-entity-reference-unsupported for undeclared named references

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>😀</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: Hexadecimal supplementary reference: the native decoder converts through a 16-bit character conversion, so U+1F600 (128512) truncates modulo 65536 to the single BMP code unit U+F600. The value is retained with a moddle-content-normalized diagnostic; U+F600 is a valid character, so the writer stage does not refuse it.
provenance: saxen decoding: numeric references use a 16-bit fromCharCode conversion
plan rev d: mirror truncation, seal 😀, retain the truncation diagnostic

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>😀</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: Decimal form of the same code point (128512 = 0x1F600) truncates identically to U+F600; decimal and hexadecimal supplementary references agree.
provenance: saxen decoding: decimal and hex branches share the 16-bit conversion
plan rev d: freeze decimal and hex supplementary-plane vectors

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>�</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: NUL reference decodes to U+0000 in the native text. F1 retains the decoded value with a moddle-content-normalized diagnostic; the writer stage then refuses that string as invalid-xml-character (expectedF7).
provenance: plan rev d: seal � and its writer-stage refusal interaction
writer string rule: NUL and forbidden controls refuse before encoding

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>�</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: Lone-surrogate reference decodes to the single code unit U+D800. The JSON form escapes it as \ud800. F1 retains it with a moddle-content-normalized diagnostic; the writer stage refuses it as invalid-xml-character. The decimal spelling � denotes the same code unit and has the same expectation.
provenance: plan rev d: seal � and its writer-stage refusal interaction
writer string rule: lone surrogates refuse before encoding

input.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"><bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="Paper kite"><bpmn:documentation>😀</bpmn:documentation></bpmn:task></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: Control: a raw valid supplementary character already present in the source text is preserved as the scalar U+1F600 (a surrogate pair in UTF-16) with no truncation and no diagnostic; only the numeric-reference spelling truncates.
provenance: plan rev d: raw valid supplementary characters remain positive cases
